rules.name: recon-snapshot-columns-01-status-all-bus
rules.sql: SELECT w.object_name, w.kind, w.expected_columns, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema = 'opera' AND c.table_name = w.object_name AND c.column_name = ANY (CASE WHEN w.expected_columns = 6 THEN ARRAY['nc_factor','fx_nc_factor','invenio_product_code','product_name','exchange_name','source_trade_id'] ELSE ARRAY['source_trade_id'] END)) AS found_columns FROM (VALUES ('recon_settle_snapshot', 'table', 6), ('recon_actual_snapshot', 'table', 1), ('recon_traders_snapshot', 'table', 1), ('helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table', 'published view', 6), ('helper_actual_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table', 'published view', 1), ('helper_traders_p_and_g_view_cache_table', 'published view', 1) ) AS w(object_name, kind, expected_columns) ORDER BY w.kind, w.object_name

SELECT p.proname, position('source_trade_id' IN p.prosrc) > 0 AS is_v4 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND p.proname IN ('recon_materialize_settle', 'recon_materialize_actual', 'recon_materialize_traders') ORDER BY p.proname

WITH ptr AS ( SELECT p.tenant_id, p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_run_id, p.published_at FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p WHERE p.tenant_id = :tenant AND p.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p2.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p2 WHERE p2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND p2.business_unit = p.business_unit AND p2.view_type = p.view_type) ) SELECT p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at, count(s.uuid) AS row_count, count(s.source_trade_id) AS has_source_trade_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.trade_id = s.source_trade_id || '-' || p.business_unit) AS suffix_ok, count(s.nc_factor) AS has_nc_factor, count(s.fx_nc_factor) AS has_fx_nc_factor, count(s.invenio_product_code) AS has_product_code FROM ptr p LEFT JOIN opera.recon_settle_snapshot s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id WHERE p.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING' GROUP BY p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at UNION ALL SELECT p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at, count(s.uuid), count(s.source_trade_id), count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.trade_id = s.source_trade_id || '-' || p.business_unit), NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint FROM ptr p LEFT JOIN opera.recon_actual_snapshot s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id WHERE p.view_type = 'SETTLE_ACTUAL_PRICING' GROUP BY p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at UNION ALL SELECT p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at, count(s.uuid), count(s.source_trade_id), count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.trade_id = s.source_trade_id || '-' || p.business_unit), NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint, NULL::bigint FROM ptr p LEFT JOIN opera.recon_traders_snapshot s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.business_unit = p.business_unit AND s.settlement_date = p.settlement_date AND s.run_id = p.published_run_id WHERE p.view_type = 'TRADERS_PRICING' GROUP BY p.business_unit, p.view_type, p.settlement_date, p.published_at ORDER BY 2, 1

expect.reason: all new columns exist on the three snapshot tables and on the three published views
all three deployed builders are the v4 versions
at least one published snapshot exists
every published snapshot row has source_trade_id: no BU is left to refresh
trade_id is exactly source_trade_id plus the BU suffix on every published row
every settle snapshot has stored nc_factor values
